discovery.summary: Check a Pennsylvania vendor against local procurement policy
discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business name once and evaluate its normalized entity type, source-published registered county, and formation age against caller-supplied policy rules. Returns proceed, human_review, or company_not_found. Proceed means only that the configured caller policy checks passed and is not legal/compliance approval or proof of good standing, ownership, authority, local operations, tax situs, fraud risk, sanctions status, or creditworthiness.
discovery.resource_description: Evaluate a prospective Pennsylvania vendor against caller-defined entity-type, registered-county, and minimum-formation-age rules using one Pennsylvania Department of State registry lookup. Returns proceed, human_review, or company_not_found. Proceed means only that the configured caller policy checks passed; it is not legal/compliance approval or proof of good standing, ownership, authority, local operations, tax situs, fraud risk, sanctions status, or creditworthiness.

buyer.task: Evaluate a prospective Pennsylvania vendor against caller-defined entity-type, registered-county, and minimum-formation-age rules using one public registry lookup.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent, verified external settled purchases and repeat demand; do not count test fixtures, discovery probes, or HTTP 200 responses as sales.

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request

parameters.allowedKinds: comma-separated set of normalized PA entity kinds

rules: Resolve a unique strong PA business registry identity before checking caller policy.
Evaluate caller allowed entity kinds, allowed registered counties and minimum formation age.
A proceed decision is an automated workflow trigger only and is not proof of compliance, local operations, or vendor trust.
